articles.summary: The German Federal Cartel Office has issued two decisions accepting Google’s commitments regarding its Google Maps Platform (“GMP”) services and its Google Automotive Services (“GAS”) offering. CRA was retained by TomTom as an intervener to support the FCO in its investigation of Google’s conduct. The CRA Team including Mikaël Hervé, Raphaël De Coninck, Romain Bizet, […]
articles.title: CRA successfully assisted client in investigation into Google’s conduct of maps and automotive services offerings
